title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: refuse a write naming no package over the package-less row of a name only disabled packages hold
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu9ukiALyKsSAq2HXPfHWBn9)_

Fixes #37499

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` teaches a save, draft save, delete or draft discard naming no package over a name only disabled packages hold; the refusal's own sentence names the fix

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在扩展包停用期间去修改、存草稿、撤草稿或删除该包某一项的定制，以前显示成功但谁也看不到这一项，现在会被拒绝并提示「先启用这个包」；重新启用后定制原样还在。
- 这是「扩展包停用后其内容全部消失」这条规矩的写入一半，读取一半此前已经做完。
- 如果判断有误，管理员会在不该被拒的地方看到「先启用包」的提示，数据不会丢，撤回本次改动即恢复原样。
- 本次改动带一条架构决策记录的补注，需要有批准权限的维护者批准后才能合并。

## What changes

A package-less `sys_metadata` row stored at a name a package holds is that package's customization (ADR-0150 D3/D4). Reads naming no package already hid it while every holder was disabled. The four writes naming no package still reached it. Measured on `main` `5dbcc02b` for a `dashboard`, on both transports and both registration orders, before and after a restart:

| Write naming no package | `main` | This branch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` | `200`, the hidden row edited | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, nothing written |
| `PUT …?mode=draft` | `200`, a draft stored that the draft read answers `404 NO_DRAFT` for | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, nothing written |
| `DELETE …?state=draft` | `200`, the draft removed | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, nothing deleted |
| `DELETE /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` | `200`, the row removed; the next enable serves the package's item without its customization | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, nothing deleted |

The refusal starts with the fix ("Enable the package that holds TYPE 'NAME' first, then send this save again"), points at `GET /api/v1/packages` and `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id/enable`, and names no package. It stays under the 500 characters a door cuts a client message at. Once a holder is enabled again, the read naming no package serves the row byte-identical to what was stored, and the same writes answer as before.

Where the change is:

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts`: `packagelessHolderRefusal`, the one judgment all four doors ask, no longer returns early when a package-less row is stored. The enabled-ambiguity arm keeps that skip, so a package-less row beside two enabled holders is written as before. A new `disabledHoldersCustomizationRefusal` carries the enable remedy. The publish-mode save also asks the judgment when the served address is the package-less row beside a disabled package's own row.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`: the draft discard judges the holders over the active rows too when a package-less row or draft is stored, so it is refused when the customization is the active row and no draft exists.
- `docs/adr/0150-…md`: a dated note under D3 records the ruling, the readings above and the controls.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.disabled-holder-package-less-row-bare-write-refused.ts`: the ADR-0087 entry the narrowed declaration owes.

Not moved, each pinned as a control: a name no package holds (`env_only_dash`) saves, drafts, discards and deletes with `200` beside a disabled package; a package-less row at a name an enabled package holds; a name only disabled packages hold with no package-less row or draft stored, which keeps its `409` and its `?package=` remedy; every read.

Decisions taken in this change, small enough not to need a card:

- The refusal names no package, as the neighbouring refusal already does, and points at the packages list instead.
- The neighbouring `?package=` refusal is kept for a name with no package-less row stored. There the named write has one row to write and nothing hidden beside it.
- The draft discard widens its judgment to the active rows only when a package-less row or draft is involved, so the cells without one do not move.

Lane measurements the card asked for first:

- After a restart: every answer above is the same before and after, on `main` and on this branch.
- `doc` and `action` (sealed against overlays): the save, the draft save and the delete answer `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` with the holder enabled or disabled, the draft discard has no draft to remove, and nothing is written. Unchanged here.
- `_env`: neither transport routes a `PUT` or a `DELETE` there, so there is no write door to close. The dispatcher also mounts no `DELETE` on a metadata item (`405`), so the delete and the discard are pinned through the REST route and the in-process `deleteMetaItem`.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`, in the `[#32605]` block, each across dispatcher and REST and both registration orders:
  - `CONTROL: the environment's own item, of a name no package holds, saves, drafts, discards and deletes as before beside a disabled D`
  - `the package-unbound row of a name only the disabled D ships is hidden with it` (four doors refused, every stored row byte-identical, re-enable serves the row, then the same writes succeed)
  - `a package-unbound draft of a name only the disabled D ships … is hidden with it` (draft beside the row, draft alone)
  - `a package-unbound row beside the disabled holder's own row … is hidden with it` (a code package and an authored package)
- `packages/objectql/src/disabled-holder-packageless-row-doors.test.ts` (review#2 S3): the pin that read the old `200` now reads the refusal and the round trip.

Readings, each under the shared verify lock with the exit code read from its VERDICT line:

- Red first, the new pins against the unfixed build: `Tests 20 failed | 100 passed | 61 skipped (181)` with `-t 32605` (the five refusal pins in each of the four arms; the control passes on both builds).
- Green, the whole file on this branch: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 181 passed (181)`.
- Affected packages, whole suites: metadata-protocol `Test Files 370 passed | 9 skipped (379)`, `Tests 23440 passed | 45 skipped (23485)`; objectql `638 passed (638)`, `14428 passed (14428)`; rest `429 passed (429)`, `8852 passed | 351 skipped (9203)`; runtime `649 passed (649)`, `12081 passed | 25 skipped (12106)`; spec `899 passed (899)`, `28498 passed | 1 todo (28499)`.
- `typecheck` of metadata-protocol, objectql, runtime and spec: exit 0 each.

The metadata-protocol, objectql, rest and runtime suites ran on `f71b5f88a` plus the objectql pin edit. The commit after it (`7e6689619`) adds the ADR note, the spec entry, the changeset and that pin, and no other source. The spec suite, the typechecks, the ablation and the dogfood battery ran on `7e6689619`.

## Acceptance notes

- "Each of the four write doors refuses in cell 1 through both transports and both registration orders": the tests above. The old CONTROL pin is split as the card says: `env_only_dash` stays `200`, `d_unbound_dash` flips to `409`.
- "An ablation pin": see Verification.
- "A disable, write attempt, re-enable round trip serves the original row byte-identical": asserted by `everyRowBytes` in the second and fourth tests above.
- "ADR-0150 D3 carries a dated note": the note dated 2026-11-26.
- "#34260 and #36229 completion criteria gain 'no write lands on a hidden item'": those are card bodies, left to the seat. Nothing in this diff writes them.
- File surface beyond the claim: the spec migration entry (the narrowed declaration requires one) and the objectql test whose pin the change flips.
- `docs/adr/**` is a governed path and the note sits under the ADR's Decision heading, so this pull request needs an authorized approval. Moving the note to its own pull request is possible if the seat prefers.
- The branch is `claude/project-thread-iu6ti1`, the name the platform assigned to this thread.
- Not folded: the draft read at `_env` for such a name answers `409` where the other reads answer `404`. It lives in other files and has its own card.

First read, by risk:

1. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts`, the tail of `packagelessHolderRefusal`: the removed early return, and the `!address.unbound` guard that keeps the two-enabled-holders cell unmoved.
2. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`, the `active` lookup for the draft discard: it must stay inside the `unbound` condition or the cells without a package-less row would move.
3. `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`, the four tests named above.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`. Expect `Tests 181 passed`.

## Verification

Summary: the ablation turns 21 tests red and the restore turns them green; all 101 derived gate families answer exit 0, three of them on a rerun once their prerequisite existed; the full dogfood battery on the head is green.

<details>
<summary>Ablation: re-allow the package-less skip in the judgment</summary>

On `7e6689619`, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold` put `if (address.unbound && 'ABLATION_37499_UNBOUND_SKIP'.length > 0) return undefined;` back at the head of the judgment in `protocol-save.ts`. Then the package was rebuilt and `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the marker in `dist/index.cjs` and `dist/index.js`.

- Ablated: `meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts` `Tests 20 failed | 161 passed (181)`, lock VERDICT `command-exit 1`; `disabled-holder-packageless-row-doors.test.ts` `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`, VERDICT `command-exit 1`.
- Restored (`--restore`, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` passes over all 24 built files): `Tests 181 passed (181)` and `Tests 5 passed (5)`, VERDICT `command-exit 0` each.

A first attempt was a no-op and is void: the replacement text still contained the anchor, the tool refused it and restored the file, and the preflight reported the marker absent from `dist/`. The readings above are from the second attempt.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Derived local gates: 101 families</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 101 commands from the seven changed paths. Each ran with its exit code recorded before any pipe, and `--ran` reconciled the record.

- 98 answered exit 0 on the first run.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: exit 3 at first (its fixture commit was outside the shallow clone); exit 0 after fetching that commit, `48 cases pass`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts`: exit 1 at first (a dependency of the CLI had no build yet); exit 0 after the build, `Tests 3 passed (3)`.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3 at first (it reads built output and some packages had no `dist/`); exit 0 after the dogfood closure build, `126 published require entry point(s) across 74 package(s) load`.

The record with those three reruns reconciles to `101 derived, 101 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.

Among them: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:api-surface`, `check:error-status-conformance`, `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:adr-index`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, each exit 0. `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` answered `VERDICT clean` before the first push, and `origin/main` at `c385d3bd16` merges cleanly and touches none of the changed files.

Not run locally, left to CI: the `repo` vitest project, the workspace type-check lanes and the build job.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Dogfood battery on the head</summary>

On `7e6689619` with a clean tree, as CI spells it: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build` (lock VERDICT `command-exit 0`), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` with no shard and no path.

- `Test Files 487 passed | 3 skipped (490)`
- `Tests 4129 passed | 68 skipped (4197)`
- lock VERDICT `command-exit 0`, held 1900s
- no failure; the head and the tree were the same after the run

</details>
